integrity: Analytic Sturm-Liouville proof plus a standalone high-precision and finite-difference numerical checker; finite checks do not certify the asymptotic statement.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional symmetric interval, fixed low modes, quadratic metric-projection penalization; asymptotic estimates are not uniform over mode indices. Gamma-function matching is classical; historical-priority review not independently complete.
title: Square-root soft-wall shift and dispersive spectral correction for penalized interval diffusion
